data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_53)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you can use delayed blast fireball once per day as a spell-like ability to throw a sphere of soul­scouring hellfire. The hellfire is a distinctive mixture of black and crimson flames in which screaming devilish faces can be seen twisting and writhing. Half the damage from this spell is fire, while the other half is unholy. This damage modification applies only to the delayed blast fireball you create through this boon, not to any other spells, effects, or attacks.
